title: Wow. Mind-Blown.
body:
So before I procrastinate in an attempt to write the perfect review for this perfect (nothing is perfect but sure feels like it) app, I'll just do this the minimalistic way:

- Exactly what I was looking for: I can track my habits.
- More than I was looking for: Gives me so many ways to customise the tracking, while remaining intuitive & simple.
- Satisfactory design & great price: Some habit tracking apps are ugly. This one's not. The price of some habit tracking apps is ridiculous. This one's not.

Wow. Thank you so much for making this useful app, putting thought, care and probably lots of love into it, while keeping the price low so it's accessible many people. Thanksss 🫶🏻

title: Great to do app
body: Very intuitive and easy to use. Helps me to stay on track with my to dos.
author: BeppiL
